activities.name: 2026 오픈소스 개발자대회 (제20회)
activities.prize_en: MSIT Minister's Award · free mentoring for winners
activities.description: 과기정통부·NIPA 주관, 20년 역사. GitHub에 오픈소스 공개하는 SW 개발 대회. 웹·앱·라이브러리·AI 도구 전 분야. 학생부·일반부 분리 심사.
activities.description_en: Hosted by MSIT and NIPA, 20-year history. SW contest where entries are published as open source on GitHub. Web, app, library, AI tools. Separate student and general divisions.
activities.tip: 접수는 마감. 출품작 제출 기간 진행 중(~08.27). 내년 6월 접수 대비.
activities.tip_en: Applications closed. Submission period running until 08.27. Prepare for next June's intake.

activities.name: Google Solution Challenge
activities.prize: Top 100 구글 본사 초청 · Top 3 트로피
activities.prize_en: Top 100 invited to Google HQ · Top 3 trophy
activities.description: GDSC 주관 글로벌 대학생 팀 대회. UN 17개 SDGs 중 하나를 기술로 해결. 전 세계 수만 팀 참가.
activities.description_en: Global university team contest by GDSC. Solve one of the UN's 17 SDGs with technology. Tens of thousands of teams worldwide.
activities.tip: GDSC 클럽 가입 후 학기 초(9~10월) 팀 구성. Firebase·GCP 사전 학습. 2027년 1~2월 모집.
activities.tip_en: Join a GDSC club and form a team early in the semester (Sep-Oct). Learn Firebase/GCP in advance. Recruiting Jan-Feb 2027.
activities.schedule_note_en: Recruiting expected Jan-Feb 2027 (every year, early in the year)

activities.name: 오픈소스 컨트리뷰션 아카데미
activities.prize: 수료증 · 멘토 추천서 · 해외 행사 참가 기회
activities.prize_en: Certificate · mentor recommendation letter · overseas event opportunities
activities.description: 실제 오픈소스 프로젝트에 현직 멘토와 함께 기여. GitHub 기여 이력 + 멘토 추천서. 외국계 기업 포트폴리오에 강력.
activities.description_en: Contribute to real open source projects with working mentors. GitHub contribution history plus mentor recommendation. Strong portfolio for global companies.
activities.tip: 글로벌 프로젝트(React, Python 등) PR 이력은 서류 통과율을 크게 높임. 참여형 하반기 모집 주시.
activities.tip_en: PRs to global projects (React, Python) strongly boost resume pass rates. Watch for the H2 participation track.
activities.schedule_note: 체험형 진행 중 · 참여형 2026 하반기 모집 예정
activities.schedule_note_en: Experience track ongoing · participation track recruiting in H2 2026

activities.name: AWS Build On / AWS Hackathon Korea
activities.name_en: AWS Build On / AWS Hackathon Korea
activities.prize: AWS 크레딧 · 장비 · 상금 · 취업 우대
activities.prize_en: AWS credits · gear · cash prizes · hiring preference
activities.description: AWS 주관. EC2·Lambda·S3 등 활용 서비스 개발 해커톤. 풀스택 + 클라우드 역량 동시 증명.
activities.description_en: Hosted by AWS. Build services using EC2, Lambda, S3. Prove fullstack and cloud skills at once.
activities.tip: AWS Free Tier 사전 실습 필수. 이벤트 페이지 수시 확인.
activities.tip_en: Practice on AWS Free Tier beforehand. Check the events page regularly.
activities.schedule_note: 연중 수시 개최 · aws.amazon.com/ko/events 공지 확인
activities.schedule_note_en: Held throughout the year · check aws.amazon.com/ko/events

activities.name: FEConf 2026 (프론트엔드 컨퍼런스)
activities.description: 국내 최대 프론트엔드 전문 컨퍼런스. 발표자 선정 시 커리어 직결. 청강만으로도 최신 트렌드 파악.
activities.description_en: Korea's largest frontend conference. Speaking directly boosts your career; attending keeps you on top of trends.
activities.tip: CFP 경쟁률 높음. 티켓 공개 즉시 매진 — 공지 알림 설정 권장.
activities.tip_en: CFP is competitive. Tickets sell out instantly; set up notifications.
activities.schedule_note: CFP 2026 여름 공지 예정 · 컨퍼런스 10~11월 예상
activities.schedule_note_en: CFP announced summer 2026 · conference expected Oct-Nov

activities.name: Kaggle Competitions (상시)
activities.description: 세계 최대 AI/ML 경진대회 플랫폼. 1,000만+ 유저. 무료 GPU 30h/주. Grandmaster = 글로벌 최고 포트폴리오.
activities.description_en: World's largest AI/ML competition platform. 10M+ users. Free GPU 30h/week. Grandmaster is a world-class portfolio.
activities.tip: Playground Series 매월 꾸준히 제출 = 등급 상승 가장 빠른 방법.
activities.tip_en: Submitting to Playground Series every month is the fastest way to rank up.
activities.schedule_note_en: Dozens of competitions running at all times

activities.name: ARC Prize 2026 (ARC-AGI-2 & AGI-3)
activities.description: François Chollet 주최 AGI 벤치마크. AGI-2 정적 추론(AI ~24%), AGI-3 동적 게임형(AI <1%). 오픈소스 의무.
activities.description_en: AGI benchmark by François Chollet. AGI-2 static reasoning (AI ~24%), AGI-3 dynamic game-like (AI <1%). Open-sourcing required.
activities.tip: AI 연구 커리어 목표 시 최고 레버리지. Milestone #2(09.30) 먼저 노려볼 것.
activities.tip_en: Highest leverage for an AI research career. Aim for Milestone #2 (Sep 30) first.

activities.name: DrivenData Competitions
activities.description: MIT·세계은행·NASA·Microsoft 후원. 사회 문제 해결 AI 대회 전문. 우승 솔루션 전부 오픈소스 공개.
activities.description_en: Backed by MIT, World Bank, NASA, Microsoft. AI competitions for social impact. All winning solutions are open-sourced.
activities.tip: NASA·WHO 등 기관 협력 이력 = 독특한 포트폴리오. 의료·환경·공공 AI 관심자 최적.
activities.tip_en: Working with NASA/WHO makes a distinctive portfolio. Great for healthcare, environment, public-sector AI.

activities.name: DACON (데이콘)
activities.description: 국내 최대 AI 경진대회 플랫폼. 누적 315+ 대회. 삼성·LG·현대·KT 협력, 채용 연계 대회 포함.
activities.description_en: Korea's largest AI competition platform. 315+ competitions to date. Partners with Samsung, LG, Hyundai, KT; some competitions link to hiring.
activities.tip: "2026 대회 모음" 포럼 스레드 즐겨찾기. 월간데이콘으로 꾸준히 연습.
activities.tip_en: Bookmark the "2026 competitions" forum thread. Practice steadily with Monthly DACON.
activities.schedule_note_en: Many competitions running at all times

activities.name: AI Factory (인공지능팩토리)
activities.prize: 대회별 상이 · 최대 25억 사업화 지원 사례
activities.prize_en: Varies · up to 2.5B KRW commercialization support cases
activities.description: 과기정통부·한국연구재단 공식 AI 플랫폼. 공신력 높은 수상 실적 — 취업·대학원 지원서에 직접 활용.
activities.description_en: Official AI platform of MSIT and NRF. Highly credible awards, directly usable on job and grad school applications.
activities.tip: 사이트 직접 접속해 현재 열린 대회 확인 필수.
activities.tip_en: Visit the site directly to check currently open competitions.
activities.schedule_note: 에너지 AI 경진대회 등 수시 모집
activities.schedule_note_en: Energy AI contest and others recruiting periodically

activities.name: 2026 Samsung AI Challenge
activities.description: 삼성리서치 주관. 분자구조·비전 AI·문서 이해 등 R&D 주제. 상위 입상 시 삼성전자 채용 연계.
activities.description_en: By Samsung Research. R&D topics like molecular structure, vision AI, document understanding. Top ranks link to Samsung hiring.
activities.tip: 7~8월 데이콘 공지 예상 — 지금이 공지 시점. 데이콘 알림 설정 필수.
activities.tip_en: Announcement expected on DACON in Jul-Aug, i.e. right now. Set DACON notifications.
activities.schedule_note_en: Expected to open Jul-Aug 2026 · watch dacon.io

activities.name: LG Aimers Hackathon 9기
activities.prize: 약 1,000만 원 + LG 그룹사 채용 특전
activities.description: LG AI연구원 주관. LLM·경량화(LoRA) 실무 주제. 온라인 예선 → 상위 100명 오프라인 본선. LG 채용 최단 경로.
activities.description_en: By LG AI Research. Practical topics: LLM, lightweighting (LoRA). Online prelims, top 100 to offline finals. Shortest path to LG hiring.
activities.tip: dacon.io에서 "LG Aimers" 검색으로 공지 즉시 파악. LLM 파인튜닝 사전 숙지.
activities.tip_en: Search "LG Aimers" on dacon.io to catch the announcement. Learn LLM fine-tuning in advance.

activities.name: 제4회 JUMP AI 신약개발 경진대회
activities.prize: 대상 장관상 + 1,000만 원 · 우수상 3팀 각 400만 원
activities.prize_en: Grand prize: Minister's Award + 10M KRW · 3 excellence awards of 4M KRW
activities.description: 보건복지부·한국보건산업진흥원 주관. Agentic AI 신약개발 주제. 개인 또는 최대 3인 팀.
activities.description_en: By Ministry of Health and Welfare and KHIDI. Agentic AI for drug discovery. Solo or teams up to 3.
activities.tip: 예선 마감 08.07 — 2주 남음. 장관상 = 공공 의료 분야 최고 레퍼런스.
activities.tip_en: Prelim deadline Aug 7, two weeks away. The Minister's Award is a top public-health reference.

activities.name: 2026 전국민 AI 경진대회 (AI 챔피언)
activities.prize_en: Total 2.6B KRW · grand prize Minister's Award
activities.description: 과기정통부 주관, 26억 원 규모 국내 최대급 AI 대회. 학생부·일반부 분리.
activities.description_en: By MSIT, one of Korea's largest AI competitions at 2.6B KRW. Separate student and general divisions.
activities.tip: 이번 회차 접수 마감. 2027년 3~4월 모집 즉시 지원 대비.
activities.tip_en: This round is closed. Be ready to apply the moment Mar-Apr 2027 recruiting opens.
activities.schedule_note_en: Finals Aug 2026 · grand finals Nov (exact dates TBA)

activities.name: NeurIPS 2026 Competitions Track
activities.description: 세계 최고 AI 학회 NeurIPS 공식 경진대회 트랙. 수상 시 학회 발표 = 학술 커리어 직결.
activities.description_en: Official competition track of NeurIPS, the top AI conference. Winning means presenting at the conference.
activities.tip: Kaggle에서 "NeurIPS 2026" 검색으로 모니터링. 8~9월 공지 예상.
activities.tip_en: Monitor by searching "NeurIPS 2026" on Kaggle. Announcements expected Aug-Sep.

activities.name: ICML 2026 (서울 개최)
activities.description: 세계 3대 ML 학회. 2026년 서울 COEX 개최 완료(07.06~11). 국내 첫 유치였음.
activities.description_en: One of the top 3 ML conferences. Held at COEX Seoul Jul 6-11, 2026, Korea's first time hosting.
activities.tip: ICML 2027 워크숍 챌린지는 2027년 초 모집. OpenReview에서 발표 논문 열람 권장.
activities.tip_en: ICML 2027 workshop challenges recruit in early 2027. Browse accepted papers on OpenReview.

activities.name: CVPR 2026 Workshop Challenges
activities.description: 컴퓨터 비전 최상위 학회. 수십 개 Workshop Challenge 운영. CVPR 논문 = CV 분야 최고 레퍼런스.
activities.description_en: Top computer vision conference with dozens of workshop challenges. A CVPR paper is the best CV reference.
activities.tip: CVPR 2027 준비 시작 — 논문 제출 ~2026.11 예정. thecvf.com 모니터링.
activities.tip_en: Start preparing for CVPR 2027; paper deadline ~Nov 2026. Monitor thecvf.com.

activities.name: ECCV 2026 Workshop Challenges
activities.description: CV 3대 학회(유럽, 격년). 다수 Workshop Challenge 현재 제출 접수 중. Kaggle 연계 챌린지도 운영.
activities.description_en: One of the top 3 CV conferences (Europe, biennial). Many workshop challenges accepting submissions now, some via Kaggle.
activities.tip: 워크숍 탭에서 챌린지 목록 확인. 대부분 7~8월 마감 예상 — 서둘러야 함.
activities.tip_en: Check the workshop tab for challenges. Most close Jul-Aug; hurry.

activities.name: ICLR 2027
activities.prize_en: Accepted paper = top DL career credential
activities.description: 딥러닝 특화 최상위 학회. Foundation Model·생성형 AI·강화학습 분야 강함.
activities.description_en: Top conference focused on deep learning: foundation models, generative AI, RL.
activities.tip: 워크숍 논문은 경쟁률 낮음 — 입문 논문 발표로 활용 권장.
activities.tip_en: Workshop papers are less competitive; good for a first publication.
activities.schedule_note_en: Paper deadline expected Sep-Oct 2026 · conference spring 2027

activities.name: Grand Challenge (의료 AI 플랫폼)
activities.description: 세계 최대 의료 AI 챌린지 플랫폼. 병리·MRI·CT·내시경·로보틱스 전 분야 300+ 활성 챌린지.
activities.description_en: World's largest medical AI challenge platform. 300+ active challenges across pathology, MRI, CT, endoscopy, robotics.
activities.tip: Active Challenges 필터로 탐색. 희소성 높아 취업 시 강력한 차별화.
activities.tip_en: Browse with the Active Challenges filter. Rare experience, strong differentiation for jobs.

activities.name: MICCAI 2026 Challenges
activities.prize_en: Winning teams present at the conference
activities.description: 의료 영상 컴퓨팅 세계 1위 학회. 매년 35+ 챌린지. 챌린지 참가 + 논문 = 학술·실무 동시 경력.
activities.description_en: The #1 conference in medical image computing. 35+ challenges yearly. Challenge plus paper builds academic and practical experience together.
activities.tip: grand-challenge.org에서 MICCAI 2026 필터 검색. 7~9월 마감 챌린지 즉시 검토.
activities.tip_en: Filter for MICCAI 2026 on grand-challenge.org. Review challenges closing Jul-Sep now.

activities.name: AMIA 2026 Public Challenge
activities.description: AMIA(미국 의료정보학회) 주관 Kaggle 챌린지. 의료 NLP·임상 정보 추출.
activities.description_en: Kaggle challenge by AMIA (American Medical Informatics Association). Medical NLP and clinical information extraction.
activities.tip: 마감 07.26 — 이틀 남음! 즉시 제출.
activities.tip_en: Deadline Jul 26, two days away. Submit now.

activities.name: Codeforces / AtCoder (상시)
activities.prize_en: Rating · prizes in some sponsored rounds
activities.description: CF Expert(1600+), AtCoder Green(800+) = 국내 코딩 테스트 통과 기준. CF 1900+ = 빅테크 직결.
activities.description_en: CF Expert (1600+) or AtCoder Green (800+) roughly equals passing Korean coding tests. CF 1900+ maps to big tech.
activities.tip: CF 주 1~3회, AtCoder ABC 격주 토 21:00 KST. BOJ 병행, 매주 꾸준함이 핵심.
activities.tip_en: CF 1-3 rounds weekly, AtCoder ABC biweekly Sat 21:00 KST. Pair with BOJ; weekly consistency is key.

activities.name: ICPC Korea 2026
activities.description: 세계 최대 대학생 알고리즘 대회. 세계 대회 진출 = 빅테크 서류 통과 보장 수준.
activities.description_en: The largest university algorithm contest. Reaching the World Finals virtually guarantees big-tech resume screening.
activities.tip: BOJ 플래티넘 이상 목표로 준비. 팀원 3인 미리 구성. 팀 등록 8~9월.
activities.tip_en: Aim for BOJ Platinum or above. Form your team of 3 early. Registration Aug-Sep.

activities.name: SCPC 2026 (삼성 프로그래밍 챌린지)
activities.prize_en: AI challenge total 70M KRW · 1st place 20M KRW
activities.description: 삼성리서치 주관 12년 역사. 올해부터 AI Agent 챌린지 트랙 신설. 이번 회차 신규 참가 불가.
activities.description_en: By Samsung Research, 12-year history. New AI Agent track this year. No new entries this round.
activities.tip: SCPC 2027은 2027년 6월 모집 예상. AI Agent + 알고리즘 실력 준비.
activities.tip_en: SCPC 2027 recruiting expected Jun 2027. Build AI-agent and algorithm skills.

activities.name: Meta Hacker Cup 2026
activities.description: Meta 주관, ICPC와 함께 알고리즘 대회 최고 권위. 연 1회.
activities.description_en: By Meta. With ICPC, one of the most prestigious algorithm contests. Once a year.
activities.tip: 8월 공지 즉시 등록. Meta 취업 직결.
activities.tip_en: Register the moment the August announcement drops. Direct line to Meta hiring.

activities.name: KT 에이블스쿨 10기 (AIVLE School)
activities.description: KT + 고용노동부. AI 개발자 / DX 컨설턴트 2개 트랙, 6개월 온라인 840시간. 4년제 6학기 이상.
activities.description_en: KT with Ministry of Employment and Labor. Two tracks: AI developer / DX consultant. 6 months online, 840 hours. Requires 6+ semesters at a 4-year university.
activities.tip: 접수 마감 08.10 — 지금 지원 가능! 온라인이라 지역 무관.
activities.tip_en: Applications close Aug 10; you can apply right now. Online, so location doesn't matter.

activities.name: SSAFY 17기 (삼성청년SW·AI아카데미)
activities.name_en: SSAFY (17th, Samsung SW·AI Academy for Youth)
activities.prize_en: Free · 1M KRW monthly stipend · 85% employment rate
activities.description: 삼성전자 운영. 12개월(기본6+심화6), 전국 5개 캠퍼스. AI 커리큘럼 강화(SSAFY 2.0).
activities.description_en: Run by Samsung Electronics. 12 months (6 basic + 6 advanced), 5 campuses nationwide. Strengthened AI curriculum (SSAFY 2.0).
activities.tip: 10~11월 모집 예상. PS(코딩테스트) + 자소서 지금부터 준비. 비전공자 Java반 별도.
activities.tip_en: Recruiting expected Oct-Nov. Prepare coding tests and essays now. Separate Java track for non-majors.

activities.name: 현대차 소프티어 부트캠프 9기
activities.prize: 무료 · 수료 후 현대차·기아 최종 면접
activities.prize_en: Free · final interview at Hyundai/Kia after completion
activities.description: 현대차·기아 공동 운영, 8주(이론 4+프로젝트 4). 2026년 AI 퍼스트로 개편. 수료 후 최종 면접 → 입사.
activities.description_en: Run by Hyundai and Kia. 8 weeks (4 theory + 4 project). Reorganized AI-first in 2026. Completion leads to a final interview and hiring.
activities.tip: React·Spring Boot 사전 학습 필수. 모빌리티 SW 관심자 최고 경로.
activities.tip_en: Learn React and Spring Boot beforehand. Best path for mobility software.

activities.name: 네이버 부스트캠프 11기
activities.description: 네이버 커넥트재단. Web/iOS/Android. 베이직(4주)→챌린지(4주)→멤버십(16주). 코어타임 필수, 고강도.
activities.description_en: By NAVER Connect Foundation. Web/iOS/Android. Basic (4w) → Challenge (4w) → Membership (16w). Mandatory core time, very intense.
activities.tip: 베이직은 선발 없음(누구나). 11기는 2027년 봄 — 지금부터 기초 다지기.
activities.tip_en: Basic has no selection (open to all). 11th intake is spring 2027; build fundamentals now.

activities.name: 크래프톤 정글 14기
activities.description: 크래프톤 운영, KAIST 정글 기반. 5개월 합숙(용인). 수료생 700+.
activities.description_en: Run by Krafton, based on the KAIST Jungle model. 5-month residential program in Yongin. 700+ alumni.
activities.tip: 14기 2027년 봄 예상. C언어·자료구조·OS 기초 지금부터.
activities.tip_en: 14th intake expected spring 2027. Start C, data structures, OS basics now.

activities.name: 우아한테크코스 9기
activities.description: 우아한형제들 운영. 백엔드/프론트/안드로이드, 10개월. 페어 프로그래밍·코드 리뷰 중심.
activities.description_en: Run by Woowa Brothers. Backend/frontend/Android, 10 months. Centered on pair programming and code review.
activities.tip: 프리코스(5주) 통과 후 선발. 9~10월 모집 예상 — Java/JS 기본기 지금 다질 것.
activities.tip_en: Selection after a 5-week precourse. Recruiting expected Sep-Oct; solidify Java/JS basics now.

activities.name: 42Seoul (이노베이션아카데미)
activities.prize: 무료 · 42 글로벌 네트워크 해외 취업 연계
activities.prize_en: Free · overseas jobs via the 42 global network
activities.description: 과기정통부 운영, 프랑스 42 모델. 강사·교재 없는 동료 피어러닝. 라피신(4주) 통과 후 본과정.
activities.description_en: Run by MSIT on the French 42 model. Peer learning with no instructors or textbooks. Pass the 4-week Piscine to enter the main program.
activities.tip: 취업보다 근본 역량 목표. 하반기 라피신 공고 주시.
activities.tip_en: Aims at fundamentals over quick employment. Watch for the H2 Piscine notice.

activities.name: GDSC (Google Developer Student Clubs)
activities.prize: 구글 멘토·리소스 · Solution Challenge 참가 기반
activities.prize_en: Google mentors and resources · base for Solution Challenge
activities.description: Google 공식 개발자 학생 클럽, 전국 100+ 캠퍼스. GDSC Lead = 구글 공식 인정 커뮤니티 리더.
activities.description_en: Google's official student developer clubs, 100+ campuses in Korea. GDSC Lead is a Google-recognized community leader.
activities.tip: Core Team(리드) 모집이 지금(7~8월)! 멤버 모집은 9~10월.
activities.tip_en: Core team (Lead) recruiting is happening now (Jul-Aug). Member recruiting is Sep-Oct.
activities.schedule_note_en: Lead recruiting Jul-Aug · member recruiting Sep-Oct

activities.name: 멋쟁이사자처럼 대학 동아리
activities.description: 전국 200+ 대학 최대 IT 동아리. HTML·CSS·JS·Django 입문. 비전공자 최적.
activities.description_en: Korea's largest university IT club across 200+ campuses. Intro to HTML, CSS, JS, Django. Great for non-majors.
activities.tip: 2학기 모집 8~9월 — 곧 시작. 각 대학 SNS 공지 확인.
activities.tip_en: Fall recruiting is Aug-Sep, starting soon. Check your campus club's SNS.

activities.name: GDG Korea (Google Developer Groups)
activities.description: Google 공인 개발자 커뮤니티. 전국 챕터 월 1~2회 정기 행사. 학생·직장인 모두 활동.
activities.description_en: Google-certified developer community. Chapters nationwide hold 1-2 events monthly. Students and professionals alike.
activities.tip: 구글 취업 목표 시 필수 커뮤니티. DevFest는 11~12월.
activities.tip_en: Essential community if you target Google. DevFest is Nov-Dec.

activities.name: 대기업 IT 서포터즈·홍보대사
activities.description: 삼성·LG·SKT·KT 등 대학생 홍보대사·기자단. 기술 콘텐츠·SNS 운영. 취업 서류에 직접 어필 가능.
activities.description_en: Student ambassador and reporter programs at Samsung, LG, SKT, KT. Tech content and SNS. Direct resume material.
activities.tip: 링커리어에서 "서포터즈" 검색 시 현재 모집 중인 것 전부 확인 가능.
activities.tip_en: Search "서포터즈" on Linkareer to see everything currently recruiting.
activities.schedule_note: 하반기 모집 10~11월 예상 · linkareer 수시 확인
activities.schedule_note_en: H2 recruiting expected Oct-Nov · check Linkareer regularly
